title: feat(nm2cycfrmx): cyclic-frame transport of (m,o_next,o_prev) at t+1 on two-axis opposite x-probes: reverse fails, face fails
science: Transport on the two-axis-opposite x-probes: fail,hold,hold,fail. Fails only where the frame itself is undefined (empty O_prev at A and D). Scalar neighbour-read fails at all four including where transport HOLDs.
